project.title: Review Serum Cấp Ẩm B5 Lumina — KOC Linh (TikTok & Reels)
project.genre: TikTok / Facebook Reels KOC Product Review
project.logline: Linh chia sẻ bí quyết cứu làn da khô mốc mùa điều hòa chỉ sau 1 tuần với Serum B5 Lumina thấm nhanh không bết dính.

continuity_bible.style_lock: Shot on Sony FX3 vertical 9:16 commercial UGC aesthetic, 35mm f/1.8 prime lens, clean bright natural daylight skin tones, soft creamy bokeh, crisp beauty-commercial color grade

ingredients.name: Linh — Beauty KOC 24 tuổi
ingredients.short_anchor: Linh, the 24-year-old Vietnamese female beauty creator in a pastel blue cardigan
ingredients.invariant_description: A 24-year-old Vietnamese woman named Linh with radiant glass-skin complexion, shoulder-length layered dark brown hair with wispy bangs, bright friendly eyes, wearing a soft pastel-blue ribbed knit cardigan over a white camisole and minimalist silver stud earrings

ingredients.name: Chai Serum B5 Lumina 30ml
ingredients.short_anchor: the frosted ice-blue glass dropper bottle of Lumina B5 Serum
ingredients.invariant_description: A sleek 30ml frosted ice-blue cylindrical glass serum bottle with a glossy white rubber pipette dropper cap and minimalist silver geometric band (Lumina B5 Serum)

shots.title: Hook 3s — Bắt nét chai Serum sát ống kính
shots.director_note: Mở đầu chuẩn KOC TikTok: đưa chai serum lại gần ống kính để rack focus sang gương mặt rạng rỡ của Linh ở vùng trung tâm trên (9:16 safe-zone), giữ chân người lướt ngay 2 giây đầu.
shots.framing: Vertical 9:16 medium close-up shot with subject centered in upper-middle two-thirds safe zone
shots.camera_move: Static tripod frame with smooth rack focus from foreground bottle to subject's eyes
shots.subject_state: Linh sits in front of a bright sunlit vanity mirror holding the frosted ice-blue glass serum bottle close to the foreground lens with a playful confident smile
shots.action: She pulls the serum bottle slightly back to chest height as focus racks crisply onto her glowing face while she speaks energetically to the camera
shots.secondary_physics: Soft morning breeze stirs a few strands of her dark brown hair while sunlight catches the frosted blue glass bottle
shots.environment: Minimalist bright bedroom vanity corner with sheer white curtains, small green eucalyptus vase, and uncluttered lower third
shots.lighting: Bright diffused morning window key light illuminating clear dewy skin with soft natural catchlights in her eyes
shots.transition_out: Fast cut on hand unscrewing dropper cap

audio.sfx: Subtle glass bottle handling sound, crisp quiet room ambience
audio.dialogue: Ngồi điều hòa cả ngày mà da vẫn căng bóng, bí kíp của Linh nằm ở em B5 này!
audio.delivery: bright, energetic, relatable young female KOC voice

shots.title: Cận cảnh ASMR giọt tinh chất B5 trong veo
shots.director_note: Cú cận cảnh ASMR chứng minh kết cấu mỏng nhẹ như nước, không đặc bết — thuyết phục thị giác người xem nữ.
shots.framing: Vertical 9:16 extreme macro close-up centered in the middle safe zone
shots.subject_state: The glass pipette tip of the frosted ice-blue Lumina B5 Serum bottle hovers just above clean moisturized skin on the back of a hand
shots.action: A crystal-clear, silky serum droplet releases smoothly from the glass pipette, lands softly on the skin, and glides effortlessly without stickiness
shots.secondary_physics: Luminous light refracts through the transparent serum drop as the lightweight liquid spreads into a dewy hydrated sheen
shots.environment: Clean sunlit pastel-blue and white studio vanity backdrop with soft creamy bokeh and uncluttered bottom margin
shots.lighting: Crisp studio rim backlight making the clear serum droplet glow like crystal against warm natural skin texture
shots.last_frame_state: Extreme macro close-up of the back of the hand glistening with an even, weightless dewy hydration sheen beside the frosted ice-blue serum bottle
shots.transition_out: Cut on motion to Linh applying serum on cheek

audio.sfx: Gentle rubber dropper squeeze, delicate crystal liquid drop landing softly on skin
audio.dialogue: Chất serum trong veo như nước, thoa tới đâu thấm tiệp mát lạnh tới đó luôn.

shots.title: Test độ căng bóng trên má (Proof)
shots.director_note: Chứng minh hiệu ứng da căng mọng đàn hồi (plump glass skin) ngay lập tức, tạo khao khát sở hữu.
shots.framing: Vertical 9:16 close-up portrait framed cleanly in the upper-middle safe zone
shots.subject_state: Linh faces the camera closely in warm natural window light with fresh hydrated skin
shots.action: She gently pats her cheek with two fingertips, showing natural bouncy skin elasticity, then beams a delighted smile straight into the lens
shots.secondary_physics: Healthy dewy specular highlight shifts smoothly across her cheekbone as she tilts her head slightly
shots.environment: Sunlit cozy vanity room with soft white curtain glow in the blurred background
shots.lighting: Golden-morning soft diffused beauty lighting highlighting smooth hydrated pores without harsh shadows

audio.sfx: Soft gentle fingertip tap on hydrated skin, quiet room tone
audio.dialogue: Đánh nền lên mượt cực kỳ, không còn cảnh mốc nền vùng cánh mũi nữa.

shots.title: Chốt đơn & Kêu gọi bấm Giỏ hàng (CTA)
shots.director_note: Linh cầm sản phẩm ngang ngực ở vùng an toàn trung tâm, tay chỉ nhẹ xuống góc trái dưới (vị trí giỏ hàng TikTok Shop / link Reels) và chốt ưu đãi.
shots.framing: Vertical 9:16 medium waist-up shot with generous safe margins at bottom and right edge
shots.subject_state: Linh sits upright holding the frosted ice-blue Lumina B5 Serum bottle clearly beside her cheek at center-left of the frame
shots.action: She nods warmly while speaking with natural lip-sync, then gestures playfully downward toward the bottom-left corner with her free hand
shots.secondary_physics: Sunlight sparkles gently along the silver band of the serum bottle as her pastel cardigan sleeve moves naturally
shots.environment: Bright tidy bedroom vanity background with plenty of clean space above her head for promo headline text
shots.lighting: Even bright natural daylight key light with crisp product visibility and warm inviting expression

audio.dialogue: Linh gắn sẵn ưu đãi ở giỏ hàng góc trái rồi, bấm săn ngay kẻo hết nha!
